description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class 'ProcessorTest' which tests the behavior of a documentation processing system, specifically focusing on building and manipulating a hierarchical tree of pages and directories via the Daux library.

classes.name: ProcessorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that verifies the behavior of the Daux documentation generator's tree processing and manipulation functionalities.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Recursively converts a node (representing a page or directory) into an associative array containing its title, URL, and children, for comparison and verification purposes.

methods.name: testAddPage
methods.description: Sets up a virtual filesystem, configures the documentation generator, manipulates the tree by adding and removing pages/directories, generates the documentation tree, and asserts the structure and content are as expected.
